english.title: Give false/misleading information to another knowing it will be given to CMA in connection with motor fuel
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gave information to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), which was false or misleading, in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL PARTICULAR..) knowing or being reckless as to whether the information was false or misleading and knowing the information would be given to the Competition and Markets Authority in connection with an information notice under section 311 of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024
english.legislation: Contrary to sections315(3) and (4) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.

english.notes:
(i) The CMA can require an undertaking involved in, or connected with, the distribution, supply or retail of motor fuel to give specified information to the CMA, for details see section 311 of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.
(ii) In case of failure a penalty may be imposed by the CMA under section 312, but a penalty under that section may not be imposed where a person has been found guilty of an offence under sections 315 in relation to the act/omission; and a person may not be found guilty of this offence if he or she has paid the penalty imposed under section 312, see section 316.
(iii) For corporate liability see section 315(5)-(8).
